model_annotation: This chart illustrates the effect size for various language models across different language families. The horizontal axis represents language model names, including XLM-R-R, XLM-R-L2, MBERT-L2, MBERT-R, XLM-B-R, and XLM-B-2, displayed in blue, green, red, and brown bars respectively, alongside several other models indicated by their color. The vertical axis represents the “effect” value, ranging from approximately -10 to +29, and uses a linear scale with tick intervals of approximately 2 and 4. Each bar is accompanied by error bars, representing standard error, and the tallest bar, representing XLM-R-R, is approximately 26, while the shortest bar, representing IE-other, is approximately 1. The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color and height.  The groupings of bars correspond to the different language models listed along the horizontal axis, with the error bars extending outward from the center of each bar.
